Episode 182. The Blind Spot of the Temporary Alliance (1)
On the first day of June, 1803.
After the operation ended, the temporary alliance publicly disclosed all the information they had gathered while facing Runcandel of Monstrosity.
The relationship between the Monstrosity and despair, the identity of the deceased prophet, the reason for Defuse's corruption, and so on.
And people around the world wore black ribbons on their chests. To mourn for those who had been sacrificed to the Monstrosity until now.
Also, to show the temporary alliance that they, as ordinary people, were fighting too.
It was an expression of their determination not to add to the Monstrosity's despair by sitting idly by.
People wearing black ribbons did not prepare for evacuation or fall into despair. They tried to continue their 'daily life' by somehow resisting the fear of the Monstrosity.
That was the way ordinary people opposed the Monstrosity.
The whole continent was striving like that.
Of course, there were quite a few who did not do so.

Some shouted that the temporary alliance was lying to cover up their incompetence, some rambled that the Runcandels of Tikan, such as Joshua, Defuse, Mu, Ann, Lan, and Vugo, were actually colluding with the Monstrosity.
But even such people had one single wish, from the deepest part of their hearts.
For this hell to end as soon as possible.
For someone to restore the world back to the way it was.
[Only the final stage remains...]
Orgal spoke.
At present, the temporary alliance was holding their final meeting for the showdown with the Monstrosity in the Tikan Palace.
"The spread of despair, as confirmed by Beradin's map, has clearly slowed down. The gain from the success of the previous operation was quite large."
Cadun spoke. In this meeting, Zifel sent him as Beradin's representative.
From an extremely cold-blooded perspective, the temporary alliance didn't lose much in this battle.
They saved about 30,000 people, although it was only about 30% of the total prisoners, and there were no fatal losses to the main forces in the process.
On the other hand, the Garden of Swords suffered a huge blow.
Firstly, the prophet disappeared. Along with the land called Recalton.
The explosion that started from the orb at the end of the battle didn't stop until it erased Recalton from the map.
Mu and Ann also met their perfect deaths due to the disappearance of the prophet.
No one witnessed their last moments. The fact remains only as an empty record.
No one paid proper attention, no one mourned.
It was a death so utterly pathetic.
Even the Tona brothers, who tormented Mu and Ann for the longest time, had already forgotten about them.
Because they were not worth remembering.
Most of all, the disappearance of part of the Monstrosity's power with Defuse was the most significant.
<The Monstrosity, is weakening.>
How much the Monstrosity had weakened could not be known even with Valeria's record magic.
But it was certain that the formation of the battleship 'Ram' was completely halted after the Recalton operation.
That meant not only had the Monstrosity weakened, but its growth had also stopped.
Therefore, the two most important factors for the final battle now were:
Can Jin win a one-on-one fight with Rosa?
Can the firepower of the battleship Ram, completed so far, be handled by the temporary alliance's forces?

"I heard that fortunately, there was no sign of the temporary alliance's forces being pushed back by the chaos army at Recalton castle. Beyond that, if there were no prophets and four knights, we might have overwhelmed them consistently. Apart from the Monstrosity and the battleship Ram, our overall forces are clearly superior."
So Cadun proposed to take on Ram with a few of their strongest forces, including himself and Orgal, and assign the rest to combat the army of chaos.

"It's like we're all serving as extras. For your duel with Rosa. As with the last operation, no other elements should interfere with your fight. Even though you ended up catching all the four knights and the prophet...... The Monstrosity will be different."
Jin smirked at his words.

"Can you handle the battleship Ram? During the first bombardment, your fleet couldn't respond to Ram's main cannon at all. Especially Cadun, you almost died. Since that day, you've been injured continuously and couldn't participate in the last operation."
Faced with Jin's blatant provocation, Cadun couldn't shout back in his usual temperament.
"I don't understand why you came to the meeting instead of Beradin."
"With Kellic absent, I am the highest authority in the family."
"I didn't expect such a timid answer from the fiery dragon Cadun, famous for his strong pride. It seems you must have received an order from Beradin not to cause trouble in the meeting, right?"

[We only have one big fight left, so there's no need to waste emotions on each other. Even though it's temporary, this alliance is unique in the world, so how about we put in a little more effort to finish on a good note?]
When Orgal spoke, Cadun shifted his gaze away from Jin.

[Anyway, unlike the first bombardment, I have regained some of my strength, and the prophet has disappeared. Therefore, the Monstrosity won't be able to properly control the battleship Ram while fighting you. Originally, the prophet would have used Ram on behalf of the Monstrosity.]
Jin didn't respond, but looked at Orgal and Cadun alternately.
Thinking about the meaning of the word 'temporary alliance'.
'Even at this point where Rosa has clearly weakened, Kinzelo and Zifl do not intend to use their secret weapons.'
Orgal's recovery and historical manipulation.
There was no reason for Kinzelo and Zifl to reveal their cards at this point.
Because they would have to use them after the fight with the monster ended, when the power struggle would start again.
Or maybe they really can't reveal them.
Because the remnants of the sun god Veil would be needed for Orgal's recovery, and Valeria's ability would be needed for historical manipulation.
'Either way, it won't go as you guys want. After finishing off the monster, it's your turn....'
Although they have crossed the death line together several times as a temporary alliance, to Jin, Zifl and Kinzelo were still other monsters.
The fact that one tries to control the world through the sun god and the other through historical manipulation does not change.
"Well, if you're confident, that's fine. Then I guess I need to ask for a favor now."
"A favor?"
[What suddenly?]
Kadun and Orgal both expressed their doubts at the same time.
"When the final battle with the monster is over safely, the temporary alliance will naturally dissolve. I think there should be an agreement not to attack each other for at least a year after that."
[It is necessary.]

"You don't think that kind of agreement becomes mandatory by stamping it on a document and announcing it to the public, do you? It's a meaningless conversation. When the war with the monster is over, everyone can do what they need to do, regardless of their own damage situation."
"I need even a verbal agreement. The most likely to be hurt in the war with the monster is me."

"Even though we were allies for a moment, the war that has lasted for a thousand years cannot end like this. I will stamp the document, but don't expect it. I refuse to verify through the contractor of Auz Mill."

"Why do you need to bring up Yuria? You should know that she's not in good condition and can't use her abilities anyway. I rather like that you keep telling me honestly, but what if I hold a grudge and join the monster?"
"Hahaha!"
At Jin's words, Kadun burst into laughter.
"Are you saying that you can do that? If you die, you're dead, you're not a human who can join the monster. I heard a funny joke for the first time in a long time."
"I'm glad you found it amusing."
"Seeing you bring this up before the final battle, it seems you are confident in your fight with the monster."
Jin answered with a smile instead.
[As Kadun said, documents and such cannot have coercive power, so how about we make a promise to each other?]

"We don't care, but the 12th Generation probably won't like it. Isn't the reason for bringing up the agreement to make the one who attacks first after the alliance breaks receive the world's criticism?"
Jin nodded.
"That's right. The world should know who breaks the promise first. Judging by the current atmosphere, it seems to be Zifl."
"Well. I don't think I should listen to someone who drains others' power and uses their secrets. We'll find out in due course."
It was a story about Hedo and the Sanctuary.
Kadun was convinced that Jin would be the first to move right after the final battle with the monster.

'If the 12th Generation subdues the monster easier than we expect, they might immediately attack us afterward. The probability of having agreed with Kinzelo in advance is high. Therefore, we should fight the monster battle with our fleet while preserving as much power as possible.'
Kadun stood up from his seat.
"Let's call it a day for now."
"I hope it will be Veradine, not you, at the meeting tomorrow."
Orgal also shrugged his shoulders and stood up from his seat.
[Everyone seems to be thinking about after the alliance breaks, but I hope there will be none of this at tomorrow's meeting. The monster is still firmly holding on in Hufester.]
The two men left the conference room with their disciples.
Jin watched their battleships disappear into the far distance of Tikan for a while, and in the meantime, Kasimir found the conference room.
"Lord Kasimir, how is Yuria doing?"
Anyway, Yuria is currently not in good condition and can't use her abilities.
When Jin said that, Kadun didn't doubt it.
Before the Licalten Castle operation started, it was known to everyone in the alliance that Yuria had received a huge psychological shock by seeing the future.
But the real reason Yuria couldn't use her abilities now was different.
"She's much better. But she seems to need some rest for the time being."
"She must have been suffering from seeing the future of Licalten Castle, and I imposed another burden on her."
"My daughter is very proud, and the soul energy she gained during verification is being well purified, so don't worry too much."
Last night.
Yuria was exposed to a bit of soul energy while verifying the words of 'Rin Milkano', who suddenly visited Tikan.
-Law Society Chairman......!?
-12th Generation, I came to tell you something.
Law Society Chairman Rin Milkano.
She was still on the side of 'RuncanDel'.
